newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: WCI's beneficial interest in TRH falls.
newsitem.headline: WCI's beneficial interest in TRH falls.

text.p: Wisconsin Central International Inc's relevant interest in Tranz Rail Holdings Ltd has fallen to 22.48 percent from 63.29 percent, Tranz Rail said in a substantial security holder notice on Tuesday.
The change reflects termination on March 18 of a shareholders' voting agreement that had been sealed when Tranz Rail was first listed.
Wisconsin's beneficial interest in Tranz Rail remains at 22.48 percent.
Wisconsin Central, Pacific Rail, Berkshire Fund, Tessaro Development and David Lloyd Investments all have a holding in Tranz Rail.
The agreement between them meant that they all had a relevant interest in each others' holding in the past.

"Now that that voting agreement has ceased, they (each) only have a relevant interest in the shares they beneficially hold, which now reduces it down to 22.48 percent," a spokesman for the New Stock Exchange said.
